based_on: dev only (20 answerable + 3 unanswerable); test not opened
criteria_file: benchmark/selection_criteria.md (committed with the benchmark before any run)
decisive_criterion: 1. Context Evidence Rate of the final context sent to the model: rerank 20/20 vs dense 18/20, inferred 18/20, hybrid 17/20 (difference 2 questions > tie threshold of 1). This criterion does not depend on manual labels.
robustness_note: If criterion 1 is read as retrieval-only Context Evidence with the original query, all configs tie at 20/20; criterion 2 (grounded mean) then gives rerank 2.00 vs dense 1.80 (2 questions), same choice. Grounded labels at decision time were AI drafts.
trade_off: rerank is about 3.7x slower per question (15.3 s vs 4.1 s; reranker on CPU, about 10.8 s per search). Cost 0 USD for all (local models).
test_plan: Run agent_dense_k3 and agent_rerank_hybrid once on test (t01-t11); retrieval eval of dense_k3 and rerank_hybrid once on test.
